title: Purpose integration
line: Clipboard entries now have a Share button that sends them to Bluetooth, email, Nextcloud, KDE Connect and other share targets.
explanation: The clipboard had no way to hand an entry to another app or device: the only option was pasting it somewhere first, and the action menu only runs configured commands. Purpose, KDE's share framework, was never used by Klipper. Each entry now has a Share button that opens a page listing Purpose's share targets (like the QR code page); links and copied files are shared as they are, text is shared as clipboard.txt and images as image.<ext> from a temporary folder.

commits.message:
klipper: add a Share button to clipboard entries

There was no way to send a clipboard entry to another app or device
without pasting it somewhere first. Entries now have a Share button that
lists Purpose's share targets, with text and images shared as files.

BUG: 366669

media.caption: Master: hovering an entry shows QR code, Edit, Remove and Star, but no way to share it
With the patch: a Share button sits next to the QR code button
Share opens a page with the available share targets (here for a copied link)
For an image, image targets such as Imgur also show up
Targets that need settings (Nextcloud) show them inside the popup, with Send and Cancel
